title: tclean cube axes on selections over one and two MeasurementSets
builds: release casars-imager and casars wheel of the committed revision in a private target directory, on the laptop, with the NEON FFTW
driver: tools/casa-compat/tclean_case_matrix.py, on a data root staged from the NAS casatestdata with its XSym links resolved
limits: exact image-product inventory and masks; NRMS <= 1e-3; the scalars and counts as the driver states them
outcome: 10 of 10 cases of tclean-two-ms-band-cases.json pass every product, and 5 of 5 of CASA's test_cube_twoMS and test_modelvis_29. Before this, two_ms_channel_selection failed: 4 channels against CASA's 18. CASA reads the band over every MeasurementSet, and lays the axis on the first one's channels from the first selected to the last, so channels 2 to 5 of the first and 8 to 12 of the second give channels 2 to 19 of the first's axis.
